title: Page 4
lines: 那只屡教永远都不会改的泼猴……这回他要是再轻易饶了她，他蓬莱二字就倒过来写一百遍！
莫追忙拉着一个劲伤心的容易，在成了危楼的书房里东闪西跳，躲避着上头不断掉下来的残砖碎瓦和四散的木屑。
“可烂摊子还摆在外头呢，二师兄，你要不去收拾的话，那往后五师兄怎么在江湖上行走？”容易辛辛苦苦十多载，名声就这么被月穹给败得精光了，这教容易以后还怎么出门找魂纸做生意？
“呜呜……我再也不要下山了……”因打不过月穹只能在这大洒男儿泪的容易，揉着通红的眼睛继续哭诉，“二师兄，你去告诉那女人，她要是不还我一个清白，我做鬼都不会放过她……”
气到极点的蓬莱，在听到他这一句话后反而冷静了下来，许久，他在唇边缓缓漾出一抹冰寒至极的笑意。
别说是做鬼都不会放过她，现下就是做人，他也不会放过那个打也打不怕、骂都无所谓、还永远都欠那么一顿教训的师妹！
“行了，别嚎了，师兄我这就给你一个交代。”他扳扳两掌，决心就在今日出清师门三害中，其中最让人恨得牙痒痒的一大害。
容易的泪水还悬在眼睫间，摆明了一副不信他的模样。
“真的？”不会又是罚跪念念佛经而已吧？
“我去后山找大师兄。”蓬莱使劲将衣袖一拂，当下说走就走。
莫追听了赶紧上前去拦下他，“二师兄，你不会是打算请家法吧？不行，大师兄这回铁定会打死四师姊的！”
“不，为了一劳永逸解决月穹那个祸害，我另有要事找大师兄商量。”就算大师兄打死了那只泼猴，都还算是便宜了她，哼，在她毁了容易的名声后，要他一笔轻轻揭过？她这回想都不要想！
“何事？”莫追光看他的气势就有种不好的预感。
“人、口、买、卖。”
本着死马当活马医的念头，文谨那日在听了文伯的建言后，便写了封委托信去给黄金门。信中他真切地表明他想要娶妻兼找保镖这事，绝对不是儿戏或愚弄，且他也愿付出深具诚意的聘礼。
只是原本不抱一丝希望的他，万万没想到，黄金门那个什么生意都做的门派，还真给了他回音。
身为黄金门代掌门人的蓬莱在回信上写道，他已按照他的要求，为他觅得一名合格的媳妇人选，要他立即起程赶往原国黄金门来迎娶他未来的新娘，且……动作愈快愈好！
被这从天而降的惊喜消息给砸得头昏眼花的文谨，愣愣地看着手中蓬莱的回信，看了很久很久……
竟然……真为他找着了个愿嫁至男儿国的新娘？
难道这是上天对多年来始终都找不到媳妇的他，所给的迟来补偿吗？他终于不必再孤家寡人下去了？
当文谨总算回过神来时，他兴奋地命文伯备齐所有聘礼，然后就按着黄金门的要求，轻车简从的上路，以十万火急的速度赶往黄金门迎娶，就深怕黄金门会突然反悔。
刚进入夏季的原国，因国中有着为数不少的山林，故而天候舒爽宜人，林间凉风习习，层层树荫遮掩的林间，将天顶骄阳摇曳成一地闪烁的光点，空气中草木清鲜的香气，更是拂去了心头的热意。
一路上都难掩焦急与喜悦之情的文谨，在马车内怎么也坐不住，他心急地揭开车帘再一次问道。
“到了吗？”
“急什么？”骑在马背上的博格朗，被他问得有点受不了，“你媳妇又不会跑了。”黄金门信誉可靠是出了名的，他们既答应接了这生意，那就必定会给他一个媳妇。
“还要多久？”文谨转头看向因赶路而赶得一脸菜色的海冬青。
“就到了，前头就是黄金门的山门。”海冬青从没听过娶媳妇还得日夜兼程的，累得七荤八素的他，抬手遥指着前方巍峨壮丽的山门。
马车抵达黄金门所在的小山山顶后，文谨刚下马车就见一名身着紫衣的男子朝他们走来，他忙整肃好衣冠，朝来者恭谨地一揖。
“在下文谨。”
“我是蓬莱，黄金门排行第二。”蓬莱漾出招牌笑容，“往后咱们就是一家人了，叫我二师兄即可。”
“二师兄。”
双方打过招呼后，文谨注意到，四下除了嘹唱着夏日清歌的蝉音，这座小山顶上便再无其他声响，且除了蓬莱之外，黄金门中的弟子们也没见着半个，一点也不像是要办喜事的样子。
他不禁有些紧张，“二师兄，我的新娘呢？”该不会是他来得太慢，所以黄金门生悔了，不愿意把人嫁给他了？
蓬莱登时僵住了嘴边和善的笑意，在他们三人质疑的目光下，他的脸色逐渐变得五颜六色好不热闹。
“没事！”蓬莱补救般地大力拍着他的肩膀，边说边带着他往大殿的方向走，“放心吧，二师兄定会抓个媳妇给你，你且等着拜堂就是！”
文谨皱着眉，“是……”用……抓的？
将文谨他们一行人安排至大殿奉茶后，走出大殿外的蓬莱一手掩着脸，深深觉得，这辈子他的脸，已经全被月穹给削光光了，只是他怎么也想不明白，神通广大的月穹，这回究竟是怎么从关她的牢房给跑了的？
说到那个让他头疼不已的月穹……打小为了教导她，他也不知究竟花上多少的心力，全师门的师弟妹们就没一个比她还要麻烦的。
总是我行我素的月穹，就像株随地乱长的野草，在她的骨子里，有种莫名强大的不屈韧性，也有种挑战这世上所有教条的叛逆。
偏偏就是这样的她，既聪明又灵巧还像只搞怪的猴子，只要是她不想接受的，那就永远也别想教她接受，哪怕是对她来硬的或是用软的，她统统都视若无睹！所以这么多年下来，大师兄已经打她打到没感觉，他则是一年到头老被她给气得肝火直冒，而底下的师弟妹们，则总因为打不过她而备受她的辣手摧残。
这回在月穹把容易的名声给彻底搞臭了，蓬莱在吐血三升后终于深刻体悟到，想让那只恣意妄为的泼猴改过向善是绝无可能的，要是不速速嫁了那个祸害，把她踢出师门去，往后的日子……大家都会继续不幸福的！
因此在与大师兄彻夜商量并敲定了这件婚事后，为免狡猾的月穹在知晓后，恐将会逃到天涯海角去避婚，蓬莱还特意以师门秘技点了她身上泰半的穴道，并将她关在精钢特制的牢房内，就是为了确保她不会落跑而搞砸了这桩婚事。
可任他千算万算，一防再防，统统都抵不过月穹那一颗想逃的心。
一大清早就发现月穹跑了后，黄金门所有内外门的弟子，眼下统统都在山里搜捕那个不知藏到哪儿去的月穹。
寻人搜物本事一把罩的莫追，是头一个发现月穹的。
同时，因技不如人的关系，他也是第一个被她打得半死的。
莫追惊险地闪过一记扇过来的掌风，小心肝颤颤地看着身后的大树倒了一大片。
月穹再接再厉地顺着风势，自怀中撒出一大包无色无味的毒粉，正忙着跑路去的她，才没闲心留在这与莫追耗时间。
“师姊，你别挣扎了，娶你的人就要到了，你快跟我回去准备拜堂吧！”莫追急忙闪过那一片毒雾，提起十成十的内劲以掌风驱散了它后，一鼓作气冲上前想揪住她的衣袖。
content_en:
That arrogant monkey who will never change despite repeated education... If he spares her easily this time, he will write the word "Peng Lai" upside down a hundred times!
Mo Zhui hurriedly held on to Yi Yi, who was heartbroken, and jumped around in the study room that had become a dangerous building, avoiding the broken bricks and tiles and scattered wood chips that kept falling from above.
"But the mess is still out there, Second Senior Brother, if you don't clean it up, how will the Fifth Senior Brother walk in the world in the future?" Yi Yi has worked hard for more than ten years, but his reputation has been completely destroyed by Yue Qiong. How can Yi Yi go out to find soul paper to do business in the future?
"Woo...I don't want to go down the mountain anymore..." Because he couldn't beat Yue Qiong, he could only shed tears here. He rubbed his red eyes and continued to cry, "Second senior brother, go tell that woman, if she doesn't return my innocence, I will never let her go..."
Penglai, who was extremely angry, calmed down after hearing his words. After a long time, a cold smile slowly appeared on his lips.
Even if he was a ghost, he would not let her go. Even if he was a human being, he would not let her go, that junior sister who was not afraid of being beaten, who didn't care if she was scolded, and who always owed her a lesson!
"Okay, stop howling, senior brother, I will give you an explanation right now." He made a move, determined to clear out the three evils in the sect today, which was the most hated one.
Easy tears were still hanging between his eyelashes, showing that he didn't believe him.
"Really?" Isn't it just a punishment for kneeling down and reciting Buddhist scriptures?
"I'm going to the back mountain to find senior brother." Penglai flicked his sleeves vigorously and left immediately.
After hearing this, Mo Zhui hurriedly stepped forward to stop him, "Second senior brother, you are not planning to ask for help from the family, are you? No, senior brother will definitely beat the fourth senior sister to death this time!"
"No, in order to solve the scourge of Yue Qiong once and for all, I have other important matters to discuss with senior brother." Even if senior brother killed the rogue monkey, it was still an advantage for her. Humph, after she ruined Yi Yi's reputation, she wanted him to take it lightly? Don't even think about it!
"What's the matter?" Mo Zhuiguang had a bad feeling just by looking at his aura.
"People, mouth, buying, selling."
Chapter 1(2)
With the idea of treating a dead horse as a living doctor, Wen Jin wrote a letter of entrustment to Golden Gate after listening to Uncle Wen's advice that day. In the letter, he clearly stated that his desire to marry a wife and find a bodyguard was definitely not a child's play or a fool's errand, and he was willing to pay a sincere betrothal gift.
It's just that he didn't have any hope at first, but he never expected that the sect of Golden Gate, which did all kinds of business, would actually give him a reply.
As the acting head of the Golden Gate, Penglai wrote in his reply that he had found a qualified wife for him in accordance with his requirements, and asked him to immediately set off to the Golden Gate of his original country to marry his future bride, and... the sooner the better!
Wen Jin, who was dizzy by the surprise news that dropped from the sky, stared blankly at Penglai's reply in his hand for a long, long time...
Actually...really found a bride for him who is willing to marry into the land of men?
Is this a belated compensation from God for him who has been unable to find a wife for many years? He finally doesn't have to be alone anymore?
When Wen Jin finally came to his senses, he excitedly ordered Uncle Wen to prepare all the betrothal gifts. Then he followed Huang Jinmen's requirements, drove Jian Cong on the road, and rushed to Huanghuangmen at an urgent speed to marry him, fearing that Huanghuangmen would suddenly regret it.
Summer has just entered the Yuan Kingdom. Because there are many mountains and forests in the country, the weather is comfortable and pleasant. The cool breeze blows in the forest. The layers of shade in the forest sway the scorching sun from the sky into twinkling light spots. The fresh fragrance of grass and trees in the air wipes away the heat in the heart.
Wen Jin, who couldn't conceal his anxiety and joy along the way, couldn't sit still in the carriage. He anxiously opened the curtain and asked again.
"Are we here?"
"What's the hurry?" Bogrand, who was riding on horseback, couldn't stand the question. "Your wife won't run away." Golden Gate is famous for its trustworthiness. Since they agreed to take over the business, they would definitely give him a wife.
"How long will it take?" Wen Jin turned to look at Hai Dongqing, who was in a hurry because he was in a hurry.
"We're here, just ahead is the gate of the Golden Gate." Hai Dongqing had never heard of someone having to travel day and night to marry a wife. He was so tired that he raised his hand and pointed at the majestic mountain gate in front of him.
After the carriage arrived at the top of the hill where the Golden Gate was located, Wen Jin saw a man in purple walking toward them as soon as he got off the carriage. He quickly straightened his clothes and bowed respectfully to the visitor.
"With all due respect."
"I am Penglai, ranked second in the Golden Gate." Penglai smiled with his signature smile, "We will be a family from now on, just call me Second Senior Brother."
"Second senior brother."
After the two sides greeted each other, Wen Jin noticed that except for the sound of cicadas singing summer songs, there was no other sound on the top of the hill. Besides Penglai, none of the disciples in the Golden Gate could be seen, and they did not look like they were celebrating a happy event.
He couldn't help but feel a little nervous, "Second senior brother, where is my bride?" Could it be that he came too slowly, so the golden disciple regretted it and was unwilling to marry him?
Penglai suddenly froze the kind smile on his lips. Under the questioning gazes of the three of them, his face gradually became colorful and lively.
"...under arrest."
"..."
"It's okay!" Penglai patted his shoulder vigorously in a remedial manner, and said as he led him towards the main hall, "Don't worry, the second senior brother will definitely find a daughter-in-law for you, just wait and see her!"
Wen Jin frowned, "It was..." Caught with...?
After arranging Wen Jin and his party to serve tea in the main hall, Penglai covered his face with one hand when he walked out of the main hall. He deeply felt that his face had been completely shaved off by Yue Qiong in this life, but he could not figure out how Yue Qiong, who had so many magical powers, escaped from the cell where she was held this time.
Speaking of the Yue Qiong that gave him a lot of headaches... He didn't know how much effort he had put into teaching her since she was a child. None of the juniors and sisters in the whole sect had more trouble than her.
Yue Qiong, who always goes her own way, is like a weed growing everywhere. In her bones, there is an inexplicable and powerful unyielding resilience, and there is also a rebellion that challenges all dogma in the world.
She is just like this, smart and dexterous but also like a funny monkey. As long as she doesn't want to accept it, you can never teach her to accept it. Even if you use hard or soft methods on her, she will turn a blind eye to it! So over the years, the senior brother had beaten her until she felt nothing. He was always angry with her all year round, and the junior brothers and sisters below were always tortured by her because they couldn't beat her.
This time in Yueqiong, the reputation of Yiyi was completely ruined. After vomiting three liters of blood, Penglai finally realized deeply that it was absolutely impossible to change the wanton monkey to become a good person. If he didn't marry the scourge quickly and kick her out of the school, in the days to come... everyone would continue to be unhappy!
Therefore, after discussing with the senior brother all night and finalizing the marriage, in order to prevent the cunning Yue Qiong from running away to the ends of the earth to avoid the marriage, Penglai specially used his master's secret skills to tap most of her acupuncture points and locked her in a special stainless steel cell, just to ensure that she would not run away and mess up the marriage.
But no matter how many times he calculated, he defended again and again, but nothing could stop Yue Qiong's desire to escape.
After discovering that Yue Qiong had escaped early in the morning, all the disciples of the inner and outer sects of the Golden Sect were now searching for Yue Qiong who was hiding somewhere in the mountains.
Mo Zhui was the first to discover the moon dome, as he was very good at finding people and things.
At the same time, he was also the first to be beaten to death by her due to his inferior skills.
Mo Zhui narrowly dodged a palm wind and watched with trembling eyes as the big tree behind him fell down.
Yue Qiong continued to follow the wind and sprinkled a large bag of colorless and odorless poisonous powder from her arms. She was busy running away, so she had no time to stay here and waste time.
"Senior sister, stop struggling. Your wife is coming soon. Come back with me and get ready to worship!" Mo Zhui hurriedly dodged the poisonous mist, used 100% of his inner energy to dispel it with the wind of his palm, and then rushed forward to grab her sleeve.
